summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting an exclusive strategic collaboration with Sino Biopharmaceutical's subsidiary CTTQ to accelerate bepirovirsen, a potential first-in-class chronic hepatitis B treatment, in mainland China. CTTQ will handle importation, distribution, and promotional activities; GSK retains marketing authorization. No deal price, premium, or board advisor disclosed. The agreement grants GSK optionality to review CTTQ's early-stage pipeline. This is a commercialization pact, not a M&A or special situation category. Watch for regulatory approval in China; no risk-arb spread as no acquisition involved.
